title: Predicting silent failures of learned inference under restricted access: what measurement physics and prior information explain
abstract: arXiv:2610.28155v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learned priors are used to reconstruct regions that measurements barely reach, and to report uncertainty there. They can fail silently: the reported interval excludes the truth while every ground-truth-free diagnostic stays within its noise. We call such errors the blind set and ask whether they can be predicted before the target data are seen. For a correctly specified linear-Gaussian model averaged over the prior, the risk of a silent failure factorises exactly into non-detection and non-coverage, which does not hold for learned systems in general; we build a score that approximates this reference by linearising a VAE prior. In a prospective study on real X-ray CT objects (2DeteCT) under simulated restricted access, with predictions committed by hash before any trial, the score ranked the realised blindness of two learned inference systems (latent Laplace and ensemble Kalman inversion) with Spearman $\rho = 0.79$ and 0.84 over 240 pr

translated_title: 预测受限访问条件下学习推理的静默失效：测量物理与先验信息能解释什么
translated_abstract: 学习先验被用于重建测量几乎无法到达的区域，并在那里报告不确定性。它们可能会静默地失败：所报告的置信区间排除了真实值，而所有不依赖真值的诊断都保持在噪声范围内。我们将这类错误称为“盲区集合”，并探究是否能在看到目标数据之前预测它们。对于一个在先验上平均后规范正确的线性高斯模型，静默失效的风险可以精确地分解为非检测与非覆盖两个因子，而这一性质对于一般的学习系统并不成立；我们通过线性化VAE先验构建了一个近似该参考基准的评分。在一项针对真实X射线CT物体（2DeteCT）在模拟受限访问条件下的前瞻性研究中——所有预测在任何试验开始之前都以哈希形式提交——该评分对两个学习推理系统（潜在拉普拉斯方法和集合卡尔曼反演）的实际盲性进行了排序，在240次试验中Spearman相关系数ρ分别为0.79和0.84……
tldr: 该论文提出“盲区集合”概念用于刻画学习推理中不依赖真值诊断无法察觉的静默失效，证明线性高斯模型下静默失效风险可精确分解为非检测与非覆盖，并通过线性化VAE先验构建评分，在真实X射线CT数据的前瞻性研究中成功预测了学习推理系统的实际盲性（Spearman ρ=0.79和0.84）。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the "blind set" concept for silent failures of learned inference that evade ground-truth-free diagnostics, shows that silent-failure risk exactly factorizes into non-detection and non-coverage for linear-Gaussian models, and builds a score by linearizing a VAE prior that prospectively ranks realized blindness of two learned inference systems on real X-ray CT data (Spearman ρ = 0.79 and 0.84).
